title: Amerika Birleşik Devletleri ve Avrupa Ekonomik İş Birliği'ne Dâhil Memleketlerle Borçlanma, Yardım ve Ödeme Anlaşmaları Akdi için Hükümete Yetki Verilmesine Dair 5969 sayılı Kanunla Muaddel 5436 sayılı Kanunun Meriyet Müddetinin Uzatılması hakkında Kanun.
extraction: lines of the PDF text layer from the law title to its last aligned line (letter-spaced spans joined)

ocr.engine: ABBYY FineReader 9.0 Professional Edition (text layer of the official scanned PDF, made by its publisher; PDF producer field)

cross_check.copy_ocr: ABBYY FineReader 9.0 Corporate Edition (text layer of the TBMM PDF)
cross_check.method: agreement = character-weighted word-sequence ratio (difflib; differing runs credited by character similarity when >= 0.75) >= 0.9, or word-bag Dice >= 0.92 (tables, whose cell order differs between two OCR reading orders); and the RG segment covers >= 0.95 of the Kanunlar Dergisi law body

in_force_basis: Resmî Gazete publication date of the as-enacted text; commencement not asserted (the law states its own entry into force)
